parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
State the formula for the de Broglie wavelength *λ* of a moving particle.

State the meaning of any other symbol used.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead:
Electrons accelerate through a potential difference, pass through a thin crystal and are then incident on a fluorescent screen.

The pattern in Fig. 8.1 is observed on the fluorescent screen.

[[fig:f1]]
parts.text: State the name of the phenomenon shown by the electrons at the crystal.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State what this phenomenon shows about the nature of electrons.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Suggest why the thin crystal causes the phenomenon in (b)(i).

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text:
The electron is accelerated through a different potential difference. The new pattern observed on the screen is shown in Fig. 8.2.

[[fig:f2]]

State and explain the change that has been made to the potential difference to create the pattern shown in Fig. 8.2.

figures.caption: Fig. 8.1
figures.alt: Concentric circular rings and a central spot are shown on a fluorescent screen, with a label pointing to the screen.

figures.caption: Fig. 8.2
figures.alt: Concentric circular rings and a central spot are shown on a fluorescent screen, with a label pointing to the screen.
